summary: UI copy rules 1-7 with audit examples, the load-bearing exceptions, and what each UI ratchet enforces. Checked against scripts/ui-copy-length.mjs, scripts/ui-copy-style.mjs, scripts/ui-css-slop.mjs, scripts/component-style-hygiene.mjs, scripts/noun-consistency-gate.mjs and package scripts.
limits: Normative contributor policy. The gate rows were checked against the scripts and their tests; the rule examples are illustrations, and passing the ratchets does not prove copy meets the rules.
